Why Choose Our Spray Dried Berry Powder?

As a leading blackberry powder exporter, we understand that consistency is the backbone of your production line. Therefore, we utilize advanced spray-drying technology. This method preserves the natural anthocyanins and antioxidants found in the fruit. Consequently, your end products retain their vibrant color and nutritional profile. Whether you need wholesale blackberry powder for beverage production or blackberry fruit powder bulk for confectionery, we deliver unmatched stability and ease of use.

Superior Manufacturing & Quality Standards

We act as a dedicated blackberry powder manufacturer, overseeing every step of the journey. First, we source premium blackberries from trusted networks. Second, we clean and prepare the fruit to ensure zero contaminants. Third, we apply precise spray-drying techniques to create a fine, uniform particle size. Finally, we conduct rigorous quality checks. Because we prioritize food safety, our facility follows strict SOPs to maintain microbial purity and moisture control. This ensures that our dehydrated blackberry powder wholesale meets international food safety standards.

Versatile Applications in Modern Food Science

Our blackberry powder for food industry use is incredibly broad. For example, beverage companies use it to create instant fruit drinks and smoothies. In the confectionery sector, it adds natural color and flavor to gummies and hard candies. Additionally, the bakery industry incorporates it into fillings and frostings. Because the powder is highly soluble, it also performs exceptionally well in dairy products like yogurt and ice cream. As a bulk blackberry powder supplier, we help you innovate with ease.

Detailed Product Specifications

We provide complete transparency regarding our technical parameters. Our typical specifications include:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh for excellent solubility.
  • Moisture Content: Less than 5% to ensure long-term stability.
